levels.surface: منصور بن عبد الرحمن ابن شيبة

notes: Two isnads carry the same saying (the woman asking how to wash after menses): two groups
«هو ابن عقبة» is an editor's gloss, left out (rule 1); «محمد» is written bare as the text gives it
«أن امرأة سألت النبي» names an unnamed asker inside the story: not a link
